axes.model_access: The Wan family runs on two tracks: the product/API side covers reference-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-video, file/web-to-video, video editing, text-to-image, image editing and image-set generation, across generations including Wan2.5 (native multimodal, audio-video sync, 10 s at 1080p/24fps) and Wan3.0 (the Alibaba Cloud product page cites 30 s and four-modality references). The open side ships Wan2.2 on GitHub/HF under Apache-2.0, with TI2V-5B running 720p/24fps on a 4090-class consumer card (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at tongyi.aliyun.com/wanxiang, mobile apps and the Alibaba Cloud Bailian API (HTTP/SDK, sync or async tasks); the open line runs the same family locally on GPUs through ComfyUI/Diffusers (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Product-side assets and works live in the Alibaba Cloud account, while the open line keeps weights, inference and outputs entirely local. The two data boundaries are distinct: API result URLs last 24 hours and must be copied out (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Cloud async tasks: creation returns a `task_id` valid for 24 hours for queries, states move PENDING → RUNNING → SUCCEEDED/FAILED, clients poll for results, and successful image/video URLs last 24 hours. The open line follows the local process, with no hosted resume (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Product/API surface: reference-to-video (video/image/audio/text inputs), image-to-video, text-to-video, file/web-to-video, general video editing, text-to-image, image editing, image-set generation, start-end frames and audio-driven avatar video. The open line includes Wan2.2 T2V/I2V/TI2V, Animate-14B and S2V-14B (2026-11-21).
axes.context: The product organises work by project and builds no cross-session chat memory; open models are stateless, with context managed by the caller through frames and prompts. Character consistency comes from reference images or start-end frames, not memory (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Product access uses an Alibaba Cloud account with credits/quotas and a Bailian API key (Bearer); the open line needs no account, and Apache-2.0 permits commercial use with licence and notice retention. Product-side training terms follow Alibaba’s agreement and privacy policy. Filing Shanghai-TongYiWanXiang-202410090024 is on record (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: a dual cloud-product plus open-weight track, image and video in one family, Chinese semantics, reference-to-video/audio-driven work and local runs for compliance-sensitive cases. Not fit: fully hosted long jobs or a product experience detached from an Alibaba account (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the Wan API page, official Wan2.5/2.6 releases, the Bailian async API and the Wan2.2 repo. Generation quality, product-tier to open-version parity and consumer-GPU viability need account and hardware testing.

related: Both domestic image+video one-stop creation benches: Wanxiang has an open-weights line, Jimeng does not.
Both open-weight image-generation families: the FLUX weight family and the Wan weight family both run in the local ecosystem.
